slang.definition_en: AI systems that can plan and take actions toward a goal.

keywords.definition_zh: 指 AI 模型能够理解和完成任务的能力水平。
keywords.example_zh: 作者认为今年模型能力明显提升，已经适合处理人类自己也难以清晰定义的问题。

keywords.definition_zh: 指能够围绕目标执行任务的 AI 智能体。

tweets.text: Going to be a big day in math https://t.co/v0sKYQLWSB https://t.co/dclzIoOPj1

This year we’ve had a clear jump in model capability where instead of telling agents precisely what to do, it’s better to use these systems to solve problems you can’t easily define yourself. 

A year ago you’d need to very clearly tell agents the how to design and develop your product idea, or there was almost no chance of success. Now, increasingly, the agent likely can come up with a better implementation than you’d have thought of because you can have it connect the dots between a far greater solution space than you can. 

This will be increasingly true in basically every domain of kneeler work. We’re going to see this impact in finance, legal, life sciences, cyber, and many other spaces where no person can hold onto all the available relevant industry knowledge to think of the best solution. 

Ultimately this is going to reshape our relationship with AI and how we deploy agents in our work. It won’t be about explicitly telling them, but instead giving them goals and enough freedom to pursue them in the best way they can.
tweets.summary_en: More capable AI agents increasingly deliver better solutions when given goals and freedom instead of detailed implementation instructions. Their ability to connect knowledge across a wider solution space could reshape work in fields such as finance, law, life sciences, and cybersecurity.

tweets.text:
Automated agentic emailing  vs the real world, a story: 

Guy emails me twice to meet at a conference (Slush)

I reply once 

He then emails me 3 times in rapid succession 

Damn that guy really wants to meet 

I bump into him later that day 

I say “well, was meant to be”

He reads my name tag, twice.

Blank face.  He clearly has no idea who  I am. 

He says “oh hi” and walks away. 

The end.

slang_glossary.definition_en: Highly focused and committed to the task.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 高度专注、全力投入某项任务。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Experimenting casually or playing with something without a fixed plan.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 随意尝试、摸索或玩一玩，没有严格的计划。

slang_glossary.definition_en: From the beginning, without relying on an existing version.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 从零开始；从头做起。

slang_glossary.definition_en: A metaphor for a repeatable, often automated system for producing software.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 把软件生产比作工厂，指可重复运行、通常包含自动化的软件开发体系。

slang_glossary.definition_en: An interface control for choosing which AI model to use.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 用于选择要使用哪个 AI 模型的界面控件。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Separate conversation histories within a messaging or AI application.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 聊天或 AI 应用中各自独立的对话及其历史记录。

slang_glossary.definition_en: Useful improvements or successful outcomes, especially in product development.
slang_glossary.definition_zh: 有价值的改进或取得的成果，产品开发中常用来指收益明显的优化。
